tasks.label: Build SQLTools release VSIX
tasks.command: $env:NODE_ENV='production'; Set-Location build-tools; node --max_old_space_size=8192 .\node_modules\webpack\bin\webpack.js --env pkg=extension; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Set-Location ..\packages\extension; & ..\..\node_modules\.bin\vsce.cmd package --yarn --allow-star-activation -o ..\..\sqltools-0.28.41.vsix }
